description.zh: 创建工作流所需的完整配置信息，包括工作流名称、定义、执行角色等
description.en: Complete configuration information required to create a workflow, including the workflow name, definition, and execution role.

descriptions.zh: 创建一个新的流程编排类型智能体。流程编排是AgentRun服务的核心组件，支持可视化编排和版本管理。
descriptions.en: Creates a flow orchestration agent. Flow orchestration is a core component of the AgentRun service that supports visual orchestration and version management.
